description: Find and score candidate guide RNAs (protospacer + PAM) in a target DNA for common nucleases (SpCas9, SpCas9-NG, SaCas9, Cas12a). PREDICTED, NOT MEASURED. No held-out skill statistic is claimed. Both are pre-2016 models, superseded by Rule Set 3 (DeWeirdt et al., Nat Commun 2022) and by DeepHF. Rule Set 3 IS now shipped here, as crispr_ontarget, and unlike these two it carries a held-out calibration: on an independent tiling library, 87.7% / 74.9% / 82.0% of its lowest-scoring guides landed in the bottom two activity quintiles. Prefer it for SpCas9 with an NGG PAM; DeepHF is still not shipped. Treat these two as a ranking aid, not an efficiency prediction. Valid for: SpCas9 with an NGG PAM and a 20 nt spacer, and only when enough genomic flanking context is present to build the model's 30-mer / 35-mer window — both scores are null rather than padded otherwise. Nothing is predicted for SaCas9, Cas12a or SpCas9-NG.

minScore.description: Only return guides with a heuristic score at least this high (0–100).

nuclease.description: Nuclease id. Omit to just list the available nucleases (no scan is performed).

searchReverseStrand.description: Also scan the reverse strand for guides.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).
